theme: Primary image routes and physical-side evidence for inscription units
question: Which missing divided-face sources and unresolved physical sides can the held primary plates resolve?
outcome: One divided-face witness recovered, reducing missing crops from 43 to 42; eight provisional face-side bridges on four of five objects, thirteen photograph bridges and 22 case-safe panel crops. All 43 acquisition routes have dispositions; two numbered export faces retain a parts-versus-sides conflict.
challenge: Export ordinal faces can differ from printed A/B labels, and one old CISI3 task was already in held CISI 2. A partial download filename misidentified a CISI 1 route. Windows A/a crop filenames collided.
remedy: Preserved first outputs and exact builder; version 2 uses explicit polarity suffixes and passes source hash, route and crop-coordinate checks. Primary captions, graphic basis, polarity, transforms, exposure and unresolved relations remain in detailed D: records.
retry_when: Obtain CISI 3.1 and 3.2 plates or primary images for the 31 catalogue routes; verify the seven inherited no-key object locators; recover four missing identities; expert-review the eight provisional bridges.
